- **Filed under:** [S02 · Storefront — PR 40–88](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s02--storefront--pr-4088)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **20 Oct** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s02--storefront--pr-4088): **V2.1 final · 20 Oct:** proven in the timing audit TA-2 (qa/TIMING-AUDIT.md, 0 fails; checklist L32/L33) — separate pause flags for mouse (hover), touch (4 s hold) and keyboard (focus), each with a tested resume; resumes within about 100 ms after the mouse leaves, after a mouse drag and after a sideways wheel; a vertical wheel is ignored (the page scrolls); every row drags with the mouse and a click after a drag never opens the card; touch hold unchanged.
  - **20 Oct** · [Scope added to existing PRs (V2.1 final · 20 Oct — pre-code demo work finished; blueprint V2.1 final; no new PR numbers)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-604): **PR 42 / 570 (slider engine, audit runner)** — the timing rules proven in TA-2 (530 checks, 0 fails; checklist L32/L33): separate pause flags for mouse, touch and keyboard; every pause has a tested resume path; sliders resume within about 100 ms after the mouse leaves, after a drag and after a sideways wheel; a vertical wheel is ignored by sliders; every row drags with the mouse and a click after a drag doesn't open the card; the toast holds on hover and focus; timers are cleared on route change; focus returns to the opener when a menu or panel closes; a cancelled pull-to-refresh resets. Phone gate 0/240, phone pixel diff 0 real changes.

## PR 596

**Side canvas — the empty left and right gutters on desktop**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “দোকানের সামনের অংশ” ধাপের অংশ: কাস্টমার যা দেখে: হোম, ক্যাটাগরি, পণ্যের পাতা, সার্চ, মেনু আর পেজ সাজানোর টুল।

**Details**

- **Status:** In demo · paused (extensions) (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Side canvas — the empty left and right gutters on desktop** (from under the header banner down to the footer, on home and category pages). The owner divides each side into free-form zones by size and position (e.g. 100 × 500 px at a set height), and puts in each zone a fixed banner, an ad, a popup trigger, or an image/animation that blends with the page background (e.g. a model stepping out in a polo, denim and boots). Per page, per zone on/off, dates; only appears where the gutter is wide enough; never covers content; off by default — today's look stays until the owner approves. Shown to the owner separately for approval first.
- **Filed under:** [S02 additions — owner's desktop review (19 Oct 18:38)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s02-additions--owners-desktop-review-19-oct-1838)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **19 Oct** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s02-additions--owners-desktop-review-19-oct-1838): **In demo (19 Oct, Shilpi + Sawdagor):** `#/admin/side-canvas` "দুই পাশের জায়গা" — live map of the page at 1280–1920 px with px/inch rulers, draw/drag/resize zones or type top/width/height, zone types banner · house ad (product/combo/category) · popup trigger (view/time/click, once per visit/day/week) · illustrated figure (polo + denim + boots from the garment drawings, entrance animation off for reduced motion) · image/animation; blend colour auto/custom, fade side, strength; sticky or anchored per zone; shows only where gutter ≥ zone width + 16 px, never over content, full-width bands, header or footer; hidden on phone/tablet. Master switch OFF ("চালু করার আগে মালিকের অনুমোদন লাগবে"); owner approval view `#/preview/side-canvas` at 1440 and 1920 with blend low/saved/high, switch untouched.
  - **19 Oct 19:53** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s02-additions--owners-desktop-review-19-oct-1838): **Owner, 19 Oct 19:53:** will turn it on; master on/off stays in the backend (off = today's look). Zones target home, all categories or chosen categories, desktop only. **Never hide — scale:** each zone has a standard reference size and scales up or down to the space each screen gives. Modes: fixed, or fixed with a gentle float of a few cm up/down while scrolling. Full-blend mode: the product sits straight on the page background with no frame, border or card edge. Animated content: a model figure changing poses, products cycling. **AI motion templates (with S24/S25):** 15–20 ready templates (colour cycle, pose cycle, turn-around, slide-up stack, flip deck, ticker, spotlight, etc.); the owner picks a template and products (e.g. every colour of the Solid Polo) and the system builds the sequence; in the real build the AI studio renders poses/short clips.

## PR 598

**Site builder — the whole site dynamic (owner, 19 Oct 21:23: "like WordPress + Elementor, nothing fixed")**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “দোকানের সামনের অংশ” ধাপের অংশ: কাস্টমার যা দেখে: হোম, ক্যাটাগরি, পণ্যের পাতা, সার্চ, মেনু আর পেজ সাজানোর টুল।

**Details**

- **Status:** In demo (partial) · paused (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Site builder — the whole site dynamic (owner, 19 Oct 21:23: "like WordPress + Elementor, nothing fixed").** From the backend, with preview before publish: **menus** (header nav / mega menu / phone menu / bottom bar — add, rename, reorder, hide, custom links, featured tile), **header** (announcement bar, icons on/off and order, logo), **footer** (columns, links, texts, contact block, social and payment marks), **categories and sub-categories** (create, rename, reorder, hide, image, intro, SEO), **product page blocks** (order and visibility of gallery, price row, colours, sizes, offers, buy-together, reviews, FAQ, care link), **content pages** (help, policies, about, careers, payment — rich text editor), **theme** (colours, fonts, spacing tokens with contrast check). Builds on PR 595 (home/category sections), 596 (side canvas) and 597 (launch default / snapshots / undo). Every change: draft → preview on phone/tablet/desktop → publish; per-device visibility; version history and undo. **Guardrails, not a blank canvas:** blocks snap to the responsive grid (no free pixel dragging that breaks phones), contrast and tap-size checks block bad publishes, checkout keeps its tested structure (texts, fields on/off and order editable; payment steps locked). Handover-ready: every default is data, a new owner configures everything here, the owner's own data never ships (PR 509).

## PR 602

**Four-layer cache plus invalidation — browser, Cloudflare, server page cache, Redis; purge rules; 15 s stock display with live checks at …**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “দোকানের সামনের অংশ” ধাপের অংশ: কাস্টমার যা দেখে: হোম, ক্যাটাগরি, পণ্যের পাতা, সার্চ, মেনু আর পেজ সাজানোর টুল।

**Details**

- **Status:** Filed (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Four-layer cache plus invalidation (owner server spec, 19 Oct 23:33).** **Browser** (images, CSS, JS, fonts for a long time, hashed file names) → **Cloudflare** (static files long; category and product pages for a few minutes, duration in settings; cart, checkout, account and admin never cached) → **server page cache** (built HTML for minutes, renewed the moment something changes) → **Redis** (settings, the Dhaka area list, products, categories, stock display). **Purge rules:** price change → that product, its category pages and the CDN; stock change → instantly; settings change → every place that setting is used; new product → category pages and the sitemap. **Stock:** the display cache lasts 15 s and every stock change event purges it at once; **add-to-bag and checkout always read live stock with a row lock (PR 198)** — nothing oversells. An admin **"Clear all cache"** button; cache hit %% on the Server page (PR 423). All durations are settings. Pre-launch required.
- **Filed under:** [S02 addition — four-layer cache (owner server spec, 19 Oct 23:33; CN-001)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s02-addition--four-layer-cache-owner-server-spec-19-oct-2333-cn-001)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **19 Oct 23:33** · [Scope added to existing PRs (owner server spec, CN-001; review/SERVER-SETUP-SPEC-OWNER.md; new PR 601–604)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-604): **The filing** — the owner approved every point of the analysis at 23:33 and said: where two decisions conflict, take the best one. Four new PRs (601 NVMe boot unit and 604 hardware-aware profile in S0A, 603 database performance pack in S00, 602 four-layer cache in S02); the rest is dated scope on the PR lines below (PR 1, 3–10, 13, 18, 22, 24, 37, 72, 88, 234, 519). **Every server item is required before go-live** — the owner's "later" list (monitoring page, monthly speed measurement, report pre-computation) is not deferred; items that need the app schema are built with their stage and marked *pre-launch required*. **Build order inside S0A:** 1 record specs (PR 1) → 2 hardening and UFW (PR 3) → 3 NVMe boot unit (PR 601) → 4 data-disk LVM (PR 1/3) → 5 Docker (PR 4) → 6 hardware-aware profile (PR 604) → 7 Postgres, PgBouncer and Redis tuning (PR 5, 6) → 8 Caddy, Cloudflare and Origin …
